[[File:Cato_Neimoidia_CotG.png|thumb|right|250px|Cato Neimoidia was a purse world]]
'''Purse world''' was a term for important [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] colony [[Planet/Legends|worlds]]. Unlike the other colonies, only the purse worlds had names that ended in "[[Neimoidia/Legends|Neimoidia]]." They served as headquarters of their own sets of colonies, and most likely functioned the same as [[Wikipedia:Protectorate|protectorates]] or [[Wikipedia:Insular area|insular areas]].

The term was later used during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in reference to strategically important [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]]-held planets or systems.
